en.text: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，外邦人进入你的产业， 变成荒堆，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，外邦人進入你的產業， 變成荒堆，

en.text: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 把你仆人的尸首交与天空的飞鸟为食，

zhTraditional.text: 把你僕人的屍首交與天空的飛鳥為食，

en.text: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. was no one to bury them.

zhSimplified.text: 在周围流他们的血如水，

zhTraditional.text: 在周圍流他們的血如水，

en.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

zhSimplified.text: 愿你将你的忿怒倒在那不认识你的外邦

zhTraditional.text: 願你將你的忿怒倒在那不認識你的外邦

en.text: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

zhSimplified.text: 求你不要记念我们先祖的罪孽，向我们追讨；

zhTraditional.text: 求你不要記念我們先祖的罪孽，向我們追討；

en.text: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

zhSimplified.text: 拯救我们的 神啊，求你因你名的荣耀帮助我们！

zhTraditional.text: 拯救我們的上帝啊，求你因你名的榮耀幫助我們！

en.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

zhSimplified.text: 为何容外邦人说「他们的 神在哪里」呢？

zhTraditional.text: 為何容外邦人說「他們的上帝在哪裏」呢？

en.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

zhSimplified.text: 愿被囚之人的叹息达到你面前；

zhTraditional.text: 願被囚之人的歎息達到你面前；

en.text: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，愿你将我们邻邦所羞辱你的羞辱

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，願你將我們鄰邦所羞辱你的羞辱

en.text: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. will praise you forever, to all generations.

zhSimplified.text: 这样，你的民，你草场的羊，

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，你的民，你草場的羊，
